
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- log_one.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- TASK WARNING -- log_one.volt:4[/yellow bold]

Task `main` has no yield points (no every/on/sleep). It will run once and complete.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware { pin led = 2 }
 [dim]4 |[/dim] task main { log("hello") }
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^[/yellow]
